replacementLog.reason: Gradle 5.2.1/6.9.2 cannot run on the frozen Java 17 platform (Groovy/Java17 incompatibility); approved replacement with Maven-based repositories.
base commit is an unpublished 2.18.0-SNAPSHOT whose parent POM is unresolvable from the public network.
base version 2.7 targets javac source/target 6, unsupported by the frozen Java 17 platform.

environmentNotes: npm caches warmed with NODE_ENV=development so devDependencies (test frameworks) are present; test execution uses NODE_ENV=test (babel env selection).
npm caches cover both instances per repository (dayjs-857+1964, grs-105+3442 dependency trees).
grs-3442 is an ESM package; jest runs via node --experimental-vm-modules.
Maven runs require -Dfile.encoding=UTF-8 / LANG=C.UTF-8 (fastjson2 has a unicode-named test class).
mockito-3220 test task is scoped to root :test (full multi-project run pulls unrelated kotlinReleaseCoroutinesTest).
